materials.name: 500 Series
materials.notes: Single and double sided boards of 1/16 in (1.6 mm) and 1/32 in (0.8 mm) with 1 oz or 1/2 oz copper. Maximum operating temperature 130 C. Thermal stress 300 s at 288 C. Resistivities after moisture resistance. Dielectric strength 1200-1400 V/mil; dielectric breakdown 60 kV; CTI grade 3 (175-250 V); peel strength 10-12 lb/in as received and 9-12 lb/in after thermal stress (ranges, not stored). Flexural strength: warp 600 MPa (lengthwise), fill 500 MPa (crosswise). UL file E214381.

materials.name: 600 Series
materials.notes: Positive presensitized FR4 boards, single and double sided, 1/16 in (1.60 mm) and 1/32 in (0.80 mm), 1 oz copper; UL file E98983. The typical values are ranges and are not stored: Tg 130-145 C (IPC-TM-650 2.4.25), CTE z 50-70 ppm/C below and 250-350 ppm/C above Tg, moisture absorption 0.05-0.3 %, peel strength 10-14 lb/in, Dk 4.2-4.7 at 1 MHz and 3.8-4.2 at 1 GHz, Df 0.015-0.020 at 1 MHz and 0.012-0.014 at 1 GHz, dielectric breakdown above 60 kV, arc resistance above 120 s. Values tested with 0.020-0.062 in samples. Decomposition 310 C at 5 % loss.
